TD-04.A // VERIFICATION FLOW

Our 5-step inspection checklist.

How we inspect, measure, and verify every batch of components before ocean dispatch.

01

Metallurgical sourcing checks

We audit steel mills at the raw material phase. We confirm chemical compositions (Carbon, Silicon, Manganese content) and tensile/yield stress boundaries, verified by Mill Test Certificates (MTC).

02

Geometric tolerance audits

Our QA team measures steel tube outside diameters (48.3mm O.D. standards), wall thicknesses (nominal 3.2mm or 4.0mm options), ovality deviations, and exact node coupling spacing intervals (500mm cups).

03

Destructive strength testing

Random components are selected and subjected to hydraulic press limits. We confirm joint load limit tolerances, weld penetration structure, standard coupler slip resistance, and ledger shear thresholds.

04

Galvanization coating measurement

Scaffolding finishes are checked using magnetic thickness gauges to guarantee hot-dip galvanization (HDG) complies with BS EN ISO 1461 rules (minimum 40 microns or 85 microns coating thickness depending on spec).

05

Container packing audits

Prior to seal lock, loading inspections verify bundle structural straps, wooden pallet blocks, cargo weight alignment, and sea-cargo securing to prevent shifts or damage inside the container.

TD-04.B // STANDARDS MATRIX

International compliance.

We manufacture and supply components that comply with global industrial specifications.

BS 1139 / EN 39

Governs tubes used in loose tube-and-fitting scaffolding setups. Ensures exact wall thickness, chemical yield boundaries, and geometric roundness tolerances.

BS EN 74-1 / EN 74

Specifies parameters for scaffolding couplers (right-angle, swivel, and sleeve couplers). Defines slip limits, failure loads, and tightening torque rules.

EN 12810 / EN 12811

Governs modular system scaffolding (Cuplock and Ring-Lock systems). Defines configuration structure calculations, horizontal ledgers deflection limits, and safety access criteria.

EN 10025 (S235 / S355)

Chemical and mechanical standards for hot-rolled structural steel grades. Guarantees yield strengths and load bearing capacities of all standards and transoms.
